additionalSources.reviewNotes: Three-run author leaderboard; thirteen models. Different grader configuration prevents matching.
Official launch article: 5,000 conversations; original GPT-4.1 grader. Read through web tool; direct HTTP capture returned 403.
Sections 4.1–4.2: OpenAI length formula, default GPT-5.4 low grader, eight samples per main comparison.
Dataset card: 42 languages, cultural annotations; no matching filtered-denominator result set.
Official repository describes lm-eval-harness, eleven languages and five-shot evaluation example. No matched filtered-denominator Sonnet result set verified.
Clean-v1 updated evaluation sets are explicitly not a direct continuation of legacy V0.
May 29 verified subset contains 115 tasks; public-page claims do not pin Sonnet’s evaluated revision.
BenchBench-Protocol is named; identity with Understanding V2 cannot be established.
Public dataset card says v11 (2026-07), 90 problems after nine removals and 24 edits. Public metadata read through web tool; raw dataset README requires authorization and was not accessed.
Earlier wet-lab campaigns use Opus 4.8/Mythos Preview. Not a separate confirmation of Sonnet’s score.

precisionPolicy: Preserve every original figure label. Prefer more precise explicit prose from the same card; do not estimate coordinates or borrow peer values from other reports.
coverageNotes: Healthcare Figure 8.15.A historical highest-Claude series does not identify individual models. Keep it as source context, not invented model rows.
Healthcare response-time coordinates are unlabeled or approximate prose ranges; no exact model timing scores inferred.
Haiku Figures 8.12.1.A/8.12.2.A clarify denominator handling for reused Sonnet/Fable/Opus values. They supply protocol evidence only; first-chart scores all come from Sonnet card.
The BioMystery network-change sentence is ambiguous; model-specific network differences retained without guessing removed/added domains.
De novo binder scoring definition is insufficient to call 82.3 a wet-lab hit rate.
